dataset.title: <dataset title as the publisher names it>
dataset.source_url: <where the data or its description is published, or null>
dataset.licence: <licence or written permission; never assume one>
dataset.status: <REAL or SAMPLE: this placeholder is deliberately invalid so the template cannot load unfilled>
dataset.spatial_resolution: <point, village, block or district: the coarsest in the file>
dataset.observation_method: <e.g. weekly pest-scout survey, 10 hills per field, ETL-based counts>
coverage_districts: <districts actually surveyed; null if the publisher does not say>
pests_surveyed: <pest ids actually surveyed, e.g. brown_planthopper; null if not stated>
